moderation.reportResolved.resolved: Thanks for your report to {community}. Your report was reviewed and acted on.

@moderation.reportResolved.resolved.description: Automatic chat message to someone who reported a message, after moderators acted on it. {community} is the community's web address.

moderation.reportResolved.dismissed: Thanks for your report to {community}. Your report was reviewed; no action was taken.

@moderation.reportResolved.dismissed.description: Automatic chat message to someone who reported a message, after moderators decided no action was needed. {community} is the community's web address.

moderation.reportResolved.escalated: Thanks for your report to {community}. Your report was escalated for further review.

@moderation.reportResolved.escalated.description: Automatic chat message to someone who reported a message, after moderators passed it on for more review. {community} is the community's web address.

moderation.reportResolved.other: Thanks for your report to {community}. Your report was reviewed.

@moderation.reportResolved.other.description: Automatic chat message to someone who reported a message, after review with an unusual outcome. {community} is the community's web address.

moderation.contentActioned: A moderator in {community} took action on your content.

@moderation.contentActioned.description: Automatic chat message to someone whose message moderators removed or hid. {community} is the community's web address. A line with the reason follows.

@moderation.banned.description: Automatic chat message to someone moderators banned. {community} is the community's web address. A line with the reason follows.

moderation.timedOut: You have been timed out in {community} until {until}.

@moderation.timedOut.description: Automatic chat message to someone moderators blocked from posting for a while. {until} is a date and time like 2026-09-01 12:00 UTC. A line with the reason follows.

moderation.timedOutNoEnd: You have been timed out in {community}.

@moderation.timedOutNoEnd.description: Automatic chat message to someone moderators blocked from posting for a while, end time unknown. A line with the reason follows.

@moderation.reason.description: Line under a moderation message; {reason} is the moderators' own text, not translated.

groups.landing.title: {name} on Kuzz

@groups.landing.title.description: Browser tab title of the web page a shared group link opens. {name} is the group name.

@groups.landing.members.description: Web page for a shared group link: member count under the group name. Short.

@groups.landing.open.description: Web page for a shared group link: big button that opens the group in the app. Short.

groups.landing.noApp: Don't have Kuzz yet? Ask the person who shared this link.

@groups.landing.noApp.description: Web page for a shared group link: small grey hint under the button.

@groups.landing.notFoundTitle.description: Browser tab title when a shared group link no longer works. Short.

@groups.landing.notFoundHeading.description: Web page heading when a shared group link no longer works.

groups.landing.notFoundHint: It may have been reset or the group may no longer exist. Ask the person who shared it for a new link.

@groups.landing.notFoundHint.description: Web page hint under 'This link doesn't work'.

@groups.landing.rateLimitedTitle.description: Browser tab title when someone opened group links too many times in a short time. Short.

@groups.landing.rateLimitedHeading.description: Web page heading when someone opened group links too many times in a short time. Short.

@groups.landing.rateLimitedHint.description: Web page hint under 'Too many requests'. Short.
